archive.catalogue_description: Description Hello ZM, this map is called Apex Home which was mapped by me, gtlad (Apex). This the version 2 of the map and was edited quite a bit from the old version. Features: BO/BO2 solo quick revive BO2 perk bottles Apex Perk And Powerup Shaders 8 Perks – 2 Unavailable to get Buyable/Winnable ending Jug is 5 hits Wonderwaffle is fixed Doubled the amout of points for nuke and carpenter when double points is active 5 new gamemodes New weapons from cod4 and black ops 2 Timed Gameplay No Dogs Song is active by pressing [use] on 3 teddy bears The song is copyrighted so if you recording for Youtube: Do not active the song or Turn your music down. Special Thanks: Rollonmath42 (Apex) Elfenlied (Apex) Jake (Apex) Tom-Bmx Beta Testers: Rollonmath42 (Apex) Elfenlied (Apex) SoloCustomZombies Dust1031 There is most likely other people for both the Special Thanks and the Beta Testers but I can’t remember. But thanks to anyone who did help.

notes: Replaces common scripts (common_scripts/utility.gsc, maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc, maps/_utility.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
